_doc: SER JACOPO dating cabinet (#45, built 2026-07-17-eve; roster #21). Pesaro school: Giancarlo Guidi (ex-Mastro de Paja, broke away 1981) founded Ser Jacopo dalla Gemma 1982. THE CLIFF = the stem logo: RED CORAL DOT (sometimes silver-ringed) 1983-1997 -> STERLING SILVER 'J' 1997+. Plus year-locked annual lines: DOMINA 1996+ (333/yr), HISTORICA 2009+ (per-year model list = EXACT dating). SOURCES: staging/pipedia/Ser_Jacopo.json (Marble Arch + smokingpipes history).

history_anchors._doc: 1981: Guidi + Bruto Sordini leave Mastro de Paja; 1982 SER JACOPO founded (Pesaro). Sordini later leaves -> Don Carlos (see doncarlos.json). Guidi dies Aug 6, 2012 (64). ~6,000 pipes/yr. Motto stamp: 'Per Aspera Ad Astra' + 'Fatta A Mano in Italia'. Grades: entry Geppetto + La Fuma Finché Tira; seconds = MODICA; top = GEM SERIES (stone on stem in 18k gold): Smeraldo<Granato<Zaffiro<Rubino<Brillante (Brillante/Diamond Gemma pipes ARE date-coded — the one SJ date code). PICTA themed series (Van Gogh, Magritte, Miró). DOMINA = pipe-of-the-year from 1996 (333 numbered). HISTORICA = annual re-edition from 2009: Delecta-2009, Nauta-2010, Senecta-2011, Luciano-2012, 30°-2013, Calabash-2014, Dome-2015, Captain Warren-2016, Lacus-2017, 35°-2018, Mons-2019, Pulchra-2020, Picta Van Gogh-2021, 40°-2022, Picta Magritte-2023, Cymatium-2024. Finish codes: R1/R2 rusticated, S/S1/S2/S3 sandblast, L/L1/L2 smooth, L3 discontinued; Maxima = oversize, Maxima Maxima = giant.

brand_marks.physical: Stem: red coral dot (early; +silver ring variant) vs sterling J (modern) vs gemstone-in-gold (Gem series). Shank: Ser Jacopo / Fatta A Mano / In Italia / Per Aspera Ad Astra + finish code.

line_years._notes: domina: annual from 1996 (each year's brochure pictures all prior — a Domina usually self-dates via its brochure/number). historica: annual from 2009; the per-year model list in anchors dates a Historica EXACTLY by model name. NOT encoded: Picta (multi-era theme), Geppetto/La Fuma/Modica (undated), finish codes (span eras; L3 'discontinued' undated).
